title: POLAR: Detecting Multilingual, Multicultural and Multievent Online Polarization
description: SemEval-2026 Task 9 (POLAR): detecting online polarization across 22 languages, many cultures, and multiple real-world events. Annotators judge whether a social-media post is polarized and, if so, identify the type of polarization and how it is rhetorically manifested (e.g. stereotyping, vilification, dehumanization, intolerance). Polarization encompasses stereotyping, vilification, dehumanization, and intolerance directed at social groups.
